assertions: The ship is lost, not safe — she is wrecked/foundered and will never return to port
The ship has sunk to the bottom of the sea: the principal significator in the 4th house and afflicted shows the end of the matter in the grave/bottom

The cargo and the merchant's goods/money aboard are also lost with no recovery of value: Part of Fortune in the 6th, its dispositor retrograde afflicted Jupiter in the 2nd in square to Part of Fortune and Moon, and Mars in his fall near the cusp of the 2nd
Loss/death afflicts those aboard: Moon lately separated from a square of Saturn, lord of the 8th, shows peril and death concerning the crew

No good news of the ship will come: Moon void of course after the Saturn square, then only applying to a trine of Saturn and afterwards to opposition of Mercury, lord of the 12th and 4th, Mercury in detriment and entering combustion, gives no safe arrival or favourable report
method: Lilly horary astrology (Christian Astrology Book II, ship question, whole-sign/classical horary rules)
reasoning: All testimonies afflict: Moon separated from square Saturn L8/L9, void of course, then to opposition of Mercury L12/L4 in detriment entering combustion, its dispositor Jupiter subterranean conjunct Mars and retrograde afflicted in 2nd squaring Moon and Part of Fortune; Mars in fall near 2nd cusp; Part of Fortune cadent in 6th; principal significator afflicted in 4th (end/bottom/grave). No benefic or unafflicted application supports safety, arrival or salvage.
summary: The ship is lost and sunk at sea, with cargo lost and grave peril to those aboard, and will not return safely.
